newsitem.title: USA: TV actor Todd Bridges charged with felony assault.
newsitem.headline: TV actor Todd Bridges charged with felony assault.

text.p: Todd Bridges, one-time star of the TV series "Diff'rent Strokes", was charged with felony assault after allegedly ramming his car into a friend's vehicle in Los Angeles's marina district, a police spokesman said Monday.
The arrest is Bridges' fourth brush with the law since 1990.

The latest incident apparently occurred after Bridges, 31, and a friend began to argue late Sunday afternoon. When the friend left the scene, Bridges followed him in his car and twice rammed it, police said.
"(Bridges) is being charged for felony assault with a deadly weapon," said Lieutenant Anthony Alba of the Los Angeles Police Department.
Bridges, remained in a downtown Los Angeles jail Monday and will be arraigned Wednesday, Alba said.

In 1993, Bridges pleaded guilty to drug possession and carrying a loaded weapon. At that time, a judge ordered Bridges into a one-year drug treatment programme and sentenced him to five years probation.
Earlier that same year, Bridges stabbed a tenant in his southern California house, but police did not file charges after determining he acted in self-defence.
In 1990, Bridges was acquitted on charges of assault with a deadly weapon after shooting an alleged crack cocaine dealer.
